description: issue #685 (slice I6), description reconciled by #686 (slice I7): with NO host input supplied, advancing the tick clock with `wait` fires no on_click handler — not because on_click can never fire during a wait, but because nothing was pending. A click is host input; in a headless run with no `executeOptions.hostInput` the pending-click queue is empty, so the registered handler body (`print "moved"`) never runs and only the registration primitive, the wait primitive, and the surrounding `print` appear. (Once I7 added `ExecuteOptions.hostInput`, a click scheduled at a tick DOES fire its on_click handler while a `wait` elapses — proven by `packages/runtime/src/interaction-dispatch-order.test.mjs`. The runtime keeps onClickHandlers out of the `every` tick path: on_click fires from a delivered pending click, never from the tick alone.)
